Ghanaian gospel singer Lady Kesewaa Kessy has released her first single of 2026, titled ‘Jesus Endorsement’, under Media Excel Productions.
The song, unveiled on October 20, explores themes of divine love, acceptance, faith and spiritual renewal, with a message centred on the belief that Jesus Christ offers grace and hope despite human imperfections.
Through its lyrics, ‘Jesus Endorsement’ presents faith as a source of reassurance and encouragement, particularly for listeners seeking spiritual affirmation and a renewed sense of purpose.
The song combines a catchy melody with heartfelt storytelling to communicate its message.
The release marks Kesewaa Kessy’s first musical offering of the year and adds to her work in Ghana’s gospel music scene, where she is known for her vocal delivery and faith-centred storytelling.
The single invites listeners to reflect on the role of faith in navigating life’s challenges and the reassurance that comes from believing in Christ’s unconditional love and acceptance.
Released under Media Excel Productions, ‘Jesus Endorsement’ is now available on digital music platforms.
